methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Capability negotiation; returns protocol version, server info, and method list.

methods.name: repos/create
methods.description: Register a local git repository.

methods.name: repos/list
methods.description: List registered repositories.

methods.name: repos/get
methods.description: Get one repository by name.

methods.name: repos/setArchived
methods.description: Archive or unarchive a repository.

methods.name: repos/setFavorite
methods.description: Favorite or unfavorite a repository.

methods.name: repos/update
methods.description: Update a repository's default branch and/or local path.

methods.name: worker/status
methods.description: Report whether the resident worker is present, fresh, and workflow-protocol compatible with this Web server.

methods.name: repos/rename
methods.description: Rename a repository's owner/name (full_name) (#485).

methods.name: repos/setMergeMode
methods.description: Pin the repo's PR-detail write action ('merge' | 'github_pr'), or 'auto' to clear it (#406).

methods.name: repos/mergeMode
methods.description: Resolved merge-mode view: raw setting, GitHub-remote presence, and the effective mode (#406).

methods.name: repos/setAgentConfig
methods.description: Set the repo's Coding agent override: toggle plus runtime/model/effort, or falls back to app defaults when off (#1532).

methods.name: repos/agentConfig
methods.description: Resolved Coding agent view: raw per-repo override (toggle + runtime/model/effort) and the effective config a run launches with (#1532).

methods.name: settings/get
methods.description: Instance-level settings (per-agent model/effort, codingAgent, devCostLimitUsd, theme, workflowContractLanguage).

methods.name: settings/update
methods.description: Update instance-level settings. model/effort require agent; theme and workflowContractLanguage are DB-backed.

devCostLimitUsd.description: Per-task USD over-budget stop threshold for implementation agents. Omit to use the $10 default. JSON Schema enforces the positive and $1,000 maximum bounds; the service additionally rejects values with more than two decimal places.

methods.name: notifications/list
methods.description: List notification-stack alerts.

methods.name: notifications/unreadCount
methods.description: Count unread notification-stack alerts.

methods.name: notifications/read
methods.description: Mark one notification-stack alert as read.

methods.name: notifications/readAll
methods.description: Mark all notification-stack alerts as read.

methods.name: workflows/contracts
methods.description: Get a run's fixed system prompts: the parent contract plus the Execute/Verify step contracts.

methods.name: workflows/list
methods.description: List global workflow definitions (Execute/Verify prompt bundles).

methods.name: workflows/create
methods.description: Create a global workflow definition.

methods.name: workflows/update
methods.description: Update a global workflow definition.

methods.name: workflows/archive
methods.description: Archive a global workflow definition.

methods.name: workflows/delete
methods.description: Delete a global workflow definition unless a running run references it.

methods.name: workflowRuns/stateForIssue
methods.description: Display state of the latest Workflow run linked to an issue, including canonical pre-merge Done and conflict state, or null when none.

methods.name: workflowRuns/stateForPull
methods.description: Display state of the latest Workflow run linked to a PR, including canonical pre-merge Done and conflict state, or null when none.

methods.name: workflowRuns/history
methods.description: List persisted lifecycle events for one Workflow run, oldest first and scoped by run id.

methods.name: workflowRuns/increaseCostLimit
methods.description: Increase a cost-held Workflow run's limit by its persisted fixed increment. The emitted event is the human continuation decision the parent resumes from (#1828).

methods.name: terminal/launch
methods.description: Launch a terminal workflow as a named Herdr session. workflow-run (Start workflow) spawns `lh workflow start --herdr` and lets it provision the worktree/PR and the herdr pane itself (#1007); the other workflows are orchestrated by this RPC directly.

methods.name: terminal/sessions
methods.description: Running herdr sessions grouped by repository, with each agent's name and status (#495), plus which running agents are pinned to a PR's worktree (pull_workspaces, #579 — drives the issue-list Herdr badge). running_repos independently lists repos whose session was confirmed running, including sessions with no visible agents; it is absent when session state could not be read.

methods.name: terminal/agentRead
methods.description: Recent terminal output for one herdr agent, for the sidebar hover preview (#500). target is a herdr `agent read` target — a pane_id, or an agent display name (e.g. "dev #486") only when it's unique within the session (herdr will not resolve an ambiguous name). output is null when herdr isn't running, the session is gone, or the agent is no longer present.

methods.name: terminal/killAgent
methods.description: Close the pane a herdr agent is running in, identified by its pane id (#521). Fails visibly (herdr not installed, session/pane already gone) rather than silently.

methods.name: terminal/focusAgent
methods.description: Switch herdr's focus to a running agent's pane, identified by its pane id (#578's herdr agent focus, reused by the issue-list Herdr badge's click action, #579). Fails visibly (herdr not installed, pane already gone) rather than silently.

methods.name: terminal/sendAgentInput
methods.description: Send one literal text input to the live Herdr agent whose pane is currently mapped to the requested PR worktree, then submit it once. The service revalidates repo, PR, and pane before writing.

methods.name: sessions/list
methods.description: List agent sessions.

methods.name: sessions/costSummary
methods.description: Small per-coding-agent cost totals for topbar display, grouped by month/week/today.

methods.name: issues/list
methods.description: List issues/PRs in a repository.

methods.name: pageData/issueList
methods.description: Get the issue list and its repository, workspace, and optional filter data in one request.

methods.name: search/query
methods.description: Search issues and pull requests in a repository.

methods.name: workspaces/list
methods.description: List registered workspaces in a repository.

methods.name: workspaces/listUnmerged
methods.description: List active workspaces with commits not merged into the default branch.

methods.name: workspaces/listArchived
methods.description: List archived workspaces in a repository.

methods.name: workspaces/listForSettings
methods.description: List registered workspaces for repository settings, excluding the default branch.

methods.name: workspaces/listArchivedForSettings
methods.description: List archived workspaces for repository settings, excluding the default branch.

methods.name: workspaces/create
methods.description: Create and register a workspace branch.

methods.name: workspaces/archive
methods.description: Archive a registered workspace.

methods.name: workspaces/unarchive
methods.description: Restore an archived workspace.

methods.name: issues/get
methods.description: Get one issue by number.

methods.name: pageData/issueDetail
methods.description: Get all initial data for one issue-detail screen.

methods.name: issues/ac/list
methods.description: List all acceptance criteria for an issue, including disabled criteria.

methods.name: issues/ac/add
methods.description: Add an acceptance criterion to an issue.

methods.name: issues/ac/setEnabled
methods.description: Enable or disable an issue's acceptance criterion.

methods.name: issues/create
methods.description: Open a new issue.

methods.name: issues/update
methods.description: Edit an issue's title/body/state/labels/target workspace.

methods.name: comments/list
methods.description: List an issue's comments.

methods.name: comments/create
methods.description: Add a human comment to an issue.

methods.name: pullComments/create
methods.description: Add a human comment to a pull request.

methods.name: pullComments/react
methods.description: Toggle a human emoji reaction on a pull request comment.

methods.name: handoffs/list
methods.description: List orchestrator<->subagent handoffs for a ref, chronological (seq asc). Filters optional: pr narrows to one PR, issue to a generic issue, session to a session.

methods.name: labels/list
methods.description: List a repository's labels.

methods.name: pulls/list
methods.description: List pull requests in a repository.

methods.name: pulls/get
methods.description: Get one pull request by number.

methods.name: pulls/usage
methods.description: Get a pull request's agent usage totals (tokens/cost).

methods.name: pageData/pullDetail
methods.description: Get all initial data for one pull-request detail screen.

methods.name: pulls/update
methods.description: Edit a pull request's title/body/state.

methods.name: pulls/archive
methods.description: Archive a pull request while preserving its history.

methods.name: pulls/unarchive
methods.description: Restore an archived pull request to active result sets.

methods.name: pulls/files
methods.description: List a pull request's changed files (diff).

methods.name: pulls/diff
methods.description: Get a stable PR diff with its exact commit pair and line coordinates.

methods.name: diffFeedback/list
methods.description: List diff feedback threads for a pull request.

methods.name: diffFeedback/get
methods.description: Get one diff feedback thread.

methods.name: diffFeedback/create
methods.description: Create a diff-anchored feedback thread.

methods.name: diffFeedback/reply
methods.description: Reply in a diff feedback conversation.

methods.name: diffFeedback/resolve
methods.description: Resolve or reopen a diff feedback conversation.

methods.name: diffFeedback/react
methods.description: Add an emoji reaction to a diff feedback message.

methods.name: pulls/commitFiles
methods.description: List files changed by one commit in a pull request, compared with its first parent.

methods.name: pulls/fileAtRef
methods.description: Whole-file content of a changed file at the PR's base or head commit (#435), for the Markdown preview modal. `status` is 'ok' (with `content`), 'missing' (the file does not exist at that side — an added or deleted file), or 'binary'.

methods.name: pulls/merge
methods.description: Merge a pull request.

methods.name: pulls/createGithubPull
methods.description: External agent surface (not used by the SPA). Submit a loophub PR to GitHub as a Draft PR (#411): push the head branch under `branch`, open (or recover) a Draft PR, and record it. Atomic — a retry recovers a created-but-unrecorded PR instead of duplicating. Same core orchestration as `lh pr create-github-pr`.

methods.name: pulls/pushGithubPull
methods.description: Push the loophub PR's current head to the branch of its already-recorded GitHub PR (#848), so commits added locally after the export reach GitHub without re-creating the PR. Records the pushed head SHA. `force` (#1861) pushes with `--force-with-lease` for a head rewritten by rebase/amend.

methods.name: pulls/githubStatus
methods.description: GitHub-side status (draft / review / checks / comment counts / merged) of a PR's linked GitHub PR (#850). Fetched on demand via `gh` and cached; 404 when the PR has no linked GitHub PR.

methods.name: pulls/debug
methods.description: Read-only debug dump for a PR: raw DB rows (issue/pull/linked issue/labels), git facts (refs, SHAs, diffstat, commits, files), reviews, comments, related events, and the dev session.

methods.name: reviews/list
methods.description: List a pull request's reviews.

methods.name: reviews/listComments
methods.description: List a pull request's line comments.

methods.name: events/list
methods.description: Poll events (webhook-style) by id cursor.

methods.name: dashboard/overview
methods.description: Cross-repo top-page overview: recently created open issues, each tagged with its repo.

methods.name: stats/get
methods.description: Database statistics: per-table row counts, DB file size (WAL included), and per-repo issue/PR tallies.

methods.name: sync/run
methods.description: External / manual surface (not used by the SPA). Sweep open-PR heads and emit pull_request.updated when a head moved. Kept alongside `lh sync` so operators can force a sweep outside the worker poll loop (see worker/maintenance.ts).
